selection_rationale: Candidate c1f8b9a2-01 (Composed Workflow Evaluation) best matches the programme goal (operational safety/reliability of LLM-driven NetOps), has clear falsifiable outcomes and preregistration-ready design, and received a favorable reviewer verdict; it directly addresses the documented gap for a reproducible composed evaluation platform (G1).
unresolved_uncertainties: Emulator/validator external validity: how well Mininet/Batfish/NetKAT checks map to real vendor devices and production topologies.
Representativeness of the intent set: synthetic/curated intents may not capture enterprise heterogeneity across vendors, protocols, and ticket styles.
Validator false-negative rate: extent to which deterministic validators miss semantic intent misinterpretations outside formalizable properties.
Model/API availability and budget constraints: potential outages or rate limits that could force deviations from preregistered call budget.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Broaden intent corpus to include vendor‑diverse, real‑world ticket templates or clearly justify synthetic sampling; stratify results by vendor/topology.
Explicitly quantify validator coverage (which properties are checked) and add tests to estimate the validator false‑negative rate (validator misses).
Define a contingency plan and logging for API outages; enforce the preregistered model‑call budget and record any deviations transparently.
Add explicit emulator→realism discussion and perform cross‑validator consistency checks (e.g., Batfish + NetKAT comparisons) and report discrepancies.
